diagnostics: Initial opening-presentation check advanced real time between fake-clock stages and skipped its locked interval. The check now pauses its virtual clock before navigation; all three engines were rechecked on the same runtime.
Small-screen layout initially allowed settings focus to shift an overflow:hidden container horizontally; overflow:clip and a compact navigation header fixed it.
320x568 and 844x390 initially had card heights below 44px; compact header/feedback sizing restores the target.
limitations: Linux WebKit and viewport resizing do not substitute for physical iOS Safari and OS keyboard testing.
Existing input/cold-warm/resource performance results remain attached to their earlier runtime; those suites were not rerun for this layout increment.
